title: Raincoat theme
description: theme.json, which names a theme. The base theme's is tokens/theme.json; every other theme's is themes/<id>/theme.json, and the directory name is the theme's id.

name.description: The theme's display name, as the documentation shows it.

description.description: One sentence on the theme's look. It goes into each platform's package description.

packages.description: Only for a theme kept outside the Raincoat repository: where its packages are published. Inside the repository the names follow ADR 0012.

npm.description: The npm package name of the theme stylesheet, such as @acme/theme-focus.

maven.description: The Maven group of the Android module, such as com.acme. The artifact is theme-<id>.
